digest.title: Microsoft releases emergency Windows updates to fix RDS failures
digest.tldr: Microsoft has released emergency out-of-band Windows updates to fix Remote Desktop Services failures caused by this month's security updates, along with Hyper-V and USB audio problems on some Windows versions.

digest.title: OpenAI stuck fighting Musk antitrust suit after Apple finds a way out
digest.tldr: Musk stops attacking Apple over ChatGPT integration but not OpenAI.

digest.title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million, report says
digest.tldr: Glass Imaging was founded by a pair of former Apple engineers who previously led the team that developed Apple's Portrait Mode.

digest.title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
digest.tldr: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.

digest.title: Webinar 9/23: NASA CSDA Program Update 2026
digest.tldr: This webinar will provide an overview of the CSDA program’s goals and activities, including the new Cal/Val initiative, and more.
